target.evidence: Proof 8.1 explicitly leaves block primitivity and exhaustiveness unproved. Proof 8.1 says primitivity and exhaustiveness are “recorded from the cited block theorem, not re-proved here.” The opened block dependency defines blocks using primitive central idempotents; it does not identify them with these content sums. The carrier asserts primitivity and exhaustiveness of nonzero content idempotents, then explicitly says these assertions are imported and not proved locally. Centrality and orthogonality do not establish primitivity. The opened block definition supplies no identification theorem, and the opened JM-center theorem concerns complex coefficients. Supply a proved local content/block theorem with the symmetric-group specialization.
